headword: {就職|しゅうしょく}{祝|いわ}い
gloss: job celebration gift; employment congratulation gift

definitions.gloss: job celebration gift; employment congratulation gift
definitions.explanation: a gift given to celebrate someone starting their first job or career

examples.japanese: {就職|しゅうしょく}{祝|いわ}い⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{名刺入|めいしい}れ→名刺入れ：27562_meishiire⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦もらった→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
examples.english: I received a business card holder as a job celebration gift.

examples.japanese: ⟦{弟|おとうと}→弟：00572_otouto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{就職|しゅうしょく}{祝|いわ}い⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{何|なに}→何：00498_nani⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{贈|おく}ろう→贈る：09862_okuru⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦{考|かんが}えている→考える：00856_kangaeru⟧。
examples.english: I'm thinking about what to give my younger brother for his job celebration gift.

examples.japanese: ⟦{内定|ないてい}→内定：07499_naitei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦もらった→もらう：00520_morau⟧⟦{息子|むすこ}→息子：00799_musuko⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{就職|しゅうしょく}{祝|いわ}い⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦スーツ→スーツ：01367_suutsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}って→買う：00489_kau⟧⟦あげた→あげる：00546_ageru⟧。
examples.english: I bought my son a suit as a job celebration gift when he received his job offer.

notes:
TIMING:
Given when someone receives a job offer (⟦{内定|ないてい}→内定：07499_naitei⟧) or starts their first job, typically in March-April when new graduates enter the workforce.

COMMON GIFTS:
- ⟦スーツ→スーツ：01367_suutsu⟧ - business suit
- ⟦{名刺入|めいしい}れ→名刺入れ：27562_meishiire⟧ - business card holder
- ⟦ペン→ペン：02960_pen⟧ - quality pen
- ⟦{腕時計|うでどけい}→腕時計：04538_udedokei⟧ - wristwatch
- ⟦{財布|さいふ}→財布：00663_saifu⟧ - wallet
- ⟦{現金|げんきん}→現金：02716_genkin⟧ - cash (typically 10,000-30,000 yen)

CULTURAL NOTE:
In Japan, starting one's career is a major life milestone. {就職|しゅうしょく}{祝|いわ}い often includes practical items for the workplace.
